name: scheduled_tasks
description: Manage scheduled tasks for app or service: list/create/update/delete/list_executions/run_once. list_executions: the command's stdout comes back in the execution's message field. run_once: composite that creates a disabled throwaway task, asks current Coolify to execute it immediately, polls list_executions every ~5s for a terminal result, then deletes the task. Older Coolify versions without the execute route fall back to enabling the existing "* * * * *" cron flow; in fallback mode the command may fire more than once before cleanup, so make it idempotent or tolerate re-execution. Coolify stores `command` in a varchar(255) column and rejects longer commands with a bodyless HTTP 500 — keep commands to 255 chars or fewer (#234).

wait_seconds.description: run_once only: poll budget in seconds before giving up (default 90)
